simple.summary: אָלַף (ʼâlaph) means causative, to make a thousandfold First listed occurrence: Ps 144 13.

definitions.full: H503. alaph II. אֶ֫לֶף noun masculine Judg 6:15 thousand ( אלף MI, SI, Sabean DHM ZMG 1875, 615 ; Arabic , Aramaic , אלפיא אֲלַף, ) — א׳(אָ֑ ׳) Gen 20:16 +; suffix אַלְמִּי Judg 6:15 ; dual אַלְמַּיִם Num 4:36 +; plural אֲלָפִים Exod 18:21 +; construct אַלְפֵי 32:28 +; אֲלָפֶיךָ Deut 7:13 2 t.; אֲלָפָיו Qr 1Sam 18:7 2 t. (Kt פֿו ) — a thousand. 1 numeral: a. used with noun alone; mostly before noun Num 35:4 ; Josh 7:3 ; Neh 3:13 ; 1Chr 18:4 +; after noun (late) 12:35 6 t. Chronicles Ezra Nehemiah; ׳א בָּאַמָּה Num 35:5 (4 t. in verse); Ezek 47:3 (strike out Co); the noun always plural when preceding, sometimes when following, 1Sam 25:2 ; 1Kin 3:4 ; 2Kin 18:23 = Isa 36:8 ; 2Chr 30:24 ; Psa 90:4 ; Job 42:12 ; Eccl 6:6 ; elsewhere singular אישׁ Judg 9:49 ; 15:15-16 , Josh 7:3 +; אַמָּה Num 35:4 + (so SI); דּוֺר Deut 7:9 +, compare 1Chr 18:4 ; 19:6 ; 2Kin 15:19 ; Job 42:12 ; Song 4:4 ; Isa 7:23 , noun sometimes collective; ׳א plural construct Micah 6:7 ; Psa 119:72 ; Gen 24:60 ; noun not expressed (or not fully) 20:16 ; Num 31:5-6 , +; distributive אֶלֶף ֗֗֗ אֶלֶף 31:4 ; multiplicative Deut 1:11 ׳א מְּעָמִים ; indefinite for great number (plural) Exod 20:6 ; 34:7 ; Deut 5:10 ; Jer 32:18 , (singular) Deut 32:30 ; Eccl 6:6 +. b. ׳א + other number usually precedes it Exod 38:25 + often; but following רִבּוֺא Ezra 2:64 2 t.; it follows also smaller number Num 3:50 ; 1Kin 5:12 (so SI); the noun following in singular Exod 28:25 8 t.; plural 2Sam 8:4 2 t.; noun precedes, in plural (late) Dan 12:12 2 t.; noun not expressed Exod 38:28 +? c. ׳א X other number always following Exod 12:37 +; usual order is no. X ׳א + additional no. (if any) + noun (if expressed) Num 31:52 ; Judg 20:35 compare Exod 12:37 ; 2Kin 3:4 (twice in verse) +; less often noun + no. X ׳א Num 31:33 ; 1Kin 8:63 +; (other combinations see Exod 38:26 ; Num 26:51 ; 31:32 ; Ezek 48:30 ; 1Chr 29:7 etc.); ׳א usually singular Num 11:21 +; except after units, where plural absolute 1:46 ; Judg 20:34 + (so MI); seldom plural construct Exod 32:28 ; Judg 4:10 ; Job 1:3 (twice in verse); (noun mostly singular when following Judg 4:10 ; 1Kin 12:21 +, yet plural Josh 4:13 ; 1Sam 13:5 +; when preceding it is plural 1Chr 5:21 +, or collective Num 31:33 ; 1Sam 25:2 ; 1Kin 8:63 ; 2Chr 7:5 +); אֲלָפִים אֶלֶף 1Chr 21:5 ; 22:14 ; 2Chr 14:8 ; שִׁנְאָן אַלְפֵי Psa 68:18 , compare שִׁנְאָן ; אָ֑לֶף בְּהַרֲרֵי 50:10 , read אֵל compare 36:7 , Ol Bi Che; yet see Hup De. — Note.10, 000= אֲלָפִים עֲשֶׂרֶת etc. Judg 1:4 ; 3:29 ; 1 Kings 5:28; 1Chr 29:7 +; less often רְבָבָה רִבּוֺ, etc. q. v. 2 a thousand , a company of 1000 men, as united under one superior, or leader, hence א שַׂר ׳(שָׂרֵי) Exod 18:21 , 25 compare Num 31:14 +; compare א ׳רָאשֵׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל 1:16 ; 10:4 ; Josh 22:21 , 30 & see below; compare also 1Sam 29:2 ; especially family , etc. Judg 6:15 ; 1Sam 10:19 (|| שֵׁבֶט & compare מִשְׁמַּחַת 10:21 ); compare Micah 5:2 ; — Num 10:36 ( יִשְׂרָאֵל אַלְפֵי רִבְבוֺת ) 31:5 ; Josh 22:14 ; 1Sam 23:23 apparently shew transition to this technical use. **[ אָלַף ] verb denominative Hiph`il Psa 144:13 מַאֲלִיפוֺת producing thousands (subject צאֹן ).
